description.en: Plugin environment backup and migration for DeepSeek Harness: backs up every profile's plugin list, plugin configs and local-source plugin tarballs into a git repo, and restores them on a new machine.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件环境备份与迁移：把各 profile 的插件清单、插件配置与本地源插件打包进 git 仓库，换机一键恢复。
